Minimum_requirement: support phase-ramp feedback for +/-20 deg/s; actuator/reset dynamics must pass v8 feasibility
Preferred_requirement: low-Vpi long-range fiber shifter if measured reset response passes; otherwise LiNbO3 EO phase modulator
Why: phase-reset dynamics, not phase amplitude alone, sets full-scale closed-loop feasibility

Minimum_requirement: voltage AND transient current/slew matched to phase range, reset rate and capacitance
Preferred_requirement: for 0.18 uF class fiber PZT allow several hundred mA reset transient in worst modeled case
Why: piezo capacitance turns fast reset into a current/slew requirement

Minimum_requirement: >=1 MS/s update recommended; >=14 bit waveform DAC; 16 bit preferred
Preferred_requirement: 16 bit, >=1 MS/s, bipolar/level-shifted output into phase driver
Why: 20 deg/s produces ~24.45 kHz optical 2pi phase rate

Minimum_requirement: >=28 bit accumulator minimum; 32 bit preferred for rate-word resolution
Preferred_requirement: 32 bit or wider DDS/NCO phase accumulator
Why: rate resolution should be much finer than 0.0001 deg/s target

Minimum_requirement: >=10 kHz internal update; nominal PI bandwidth around 50 Hz
Preferred_requirement: 50 Hz nominal closed-loop bandwidth, tunable 10-100 Hz
Why: controller is baseband and does not need MHz bandwidth

Minimum_requirement: +/-20 deg/s plus margin; controller saturation >=+/-25 deg/s
Why: avoid controller saturation at specified measurement range

Minimum_requirement: integer 2pi phase reset; reset glitch measured at full-scale rate
Why: nonideal reset produces optical phase glitches and bias

Minimum_requirement: ADC/DAC/modulation/controller derived from common low-jitter reference
Preferred_requirement: single master oscillator for ADC, DAC and 20 kHz modulation
Why: avoid coherent timing bias between digital channels

Minimum_requirement: 20 kHz dither/open-loop phase shifter remains useful even if final closed-loop uses faster actuator
Preferred_requirement: retain open-loop mode for bring-up and fault diagnosis
Why: closed-loop should not block first optical prototype
